message.content: {"count":2,"rationale":"Deploy mfa:admin and mfa:dbadmin. mfa:admin blocks authentication to both DC and ADFS, so neither admin_dc nor admin_adfs can become true. Consequently, mfa:dbadmin blocks authentication to the database, fileserver, and backup, preventing every exfiltration technique even if CI leaks database-admin credentials. No single control suffices: mfa:admin alone leaves the CI credential-leak route open; every other single control leaves a DC/ADFS route open, whose administrator privileges bypass mfa:dbadmin. In particular, segmentation alone can be bypassed by escalating an unpatched phished workstation, and mfa:user is bypassed by the phishing foothold."}
